prompt:
A transparent RGBA sprite atlas for an animated FERAL PREDATOR (the lean Feral Hunter from Prey) in a hand-painted 2D fighting game. Draw NEW distinct articulated poses, never mirrored copies. His exact recurring identity: lean sinewy ochre-orange spotted skin, long black dreadlocks, asymmetric ivory bone-skull mask with red exposed mandibles, bare narrow muscular chest, black-and-bronze segmented loincloth, bone hip ornaments, dark forearm bracers, wrapped ankles and clawed bare toes. No shoulder cannon, no plasma gun. Same body proportions, outfit and fixed bodily scale throughout.

CRITICAL COMPOSITION: exactly TWELVE SMALL full-body sprites arranged in a perfectly regular THREE-COLUMN, FOUR-ROW grid on a1536x1024 landscape canvas. Invisible cells are512x256. Draw each whole body about140 pixels tall centered at the following exact cell centers: row1:(256,128),(768,128),(1280,128); row2:(256,384),(768,384),(1280,384); row3:(256,640),(768,640),(1280,640); row4:(256,896),(768,896),(1280,896). Leave large EMPTY transparent areas around every body. Keep all weapons inside their own cell. Never add a fourth column. Every one of the twelve cells contains exactly one actor. No body cropped at an edge.

BACKGROUND: alpha0 empty pixels everywhere outside the precise character/weapon silhouettes. Absolutely NO brown/black/gray backdrop, no shadow, no floor, no atmospheric wash, no halo, no glow, no frames, grid lines, text or numbers. This is a sparse clean CUTOUT ATLAS, not a poster or contact sheet on a colored backdrop. Crisp narrow edge antialias only. Over70% of the entire canvas should be completely empty transparent negative space.

ACTION in SIX clearly different stages, read across rows1 and2: (1) left-anatomical forearm shield completely folded, both blades on right wrist fully retracted, neutral grounded guard; (2) left arm lifts and radial shield segments half-unfold visibly; (3) fully deployed circular segmented shield blocking in front of the left forearm; (4) short forward shield-edge bash with distinct bent knee and hip/torso extension, right arm naturally drawn behind; (5) pull left arm back and half-fold the disk; (6) completely folded shield along left bracer and return to neutral. No duplicate shields.

Rows1 and2: the six stages all FACE RIGHT, front/right-side view, left shield arm farther from viewer, right wrist nearer.
Rows3 and4: independently redraw the same six stages all FACE LEFT, back/left-side view; left shield arm now nearer viewer, right wrist farther. This must show Feral's back details and correct anatomical left arm rather than a horizontal reflection. Maintain clean humanlike five-clawed fingers, exactly two arms and two legs. Do not change direction within a row pair.
referenceMode: New drawings from inspected source identity; old sheets not passed because their painted halos contaminated the first two pages.
